visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards and modals, rounded-full for action buttons, rounded-xl for inner elements
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for default surfaces, shadow-md for interactive cards on hover, shadow-xl for modals/bottom sheets
visual_enhancers.spacing: Use comfortable mobile-friendly spacing. p-4 to p-6 inside cards. gap-4 between list items.

components.cards: White background, rounded-2xl, border border-slate-200. Padding p-4 or p-5. Clean and uncrowded.
components.buttons: Primary buttons should be highly prominent: bg-orange-500 text-white rounded-full font-semibold px-6 py-3.5 shadow-sm active:scale-95. Secondary buttons: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-full.
components.bottom_nav: Fixed at the bottom. bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-around items-center h-16 pb-safe z-50.
components.header: Sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-100. DO NOT leave transparent if content scrolls beneath.
components.status_timeline: Vertical line with dots. Active state dot in primary orange, completed in success green, pending in slate-300.
components.comparison_card: Side-by-side flex layout. Clear distinct borders. 'Approve' button clearly marked in green.
components.chat_bubble: Customer messages: bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm text-slate-800. PA messages: bg-orange-100 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm text-orange-900.

layouts.customer_app: Mobile-first approach. Use a container like max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 relative overflow-x-hidden for web-view simulation.
layouts.pa_app: Mobile-first approach. max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 relative.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Desktop layout. grid grid-cols-[250px_1fr] min-h-screen bg-slate-50. Fixed sidebar with dark or light theme, main content area with ample p-8 padding.

motion.page_transition: Use Framer Motion for smooth screen transitions if possible, or basic CSS fade.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Do not use white text on light orange. Ensure the primary orange (#F97316) is used with white text only if contrast is sufficient, else use darker orange.
accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure all icons have descriptive aria-labels if they are buttons.

media.icons: lucide-react for consistent, clean vector icons. Stroke width 2.

local_market.description: Indian local market scene, for service category or banner.

delivery_person.description: Delivery person in India, useful for PA profile or hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the IntownPA MVP interfaces (Customer App, PA App, Admin Dashboard). Use a mobile-width wrapper for the customer/PA app views to mimic mobile on desktop browsers. Implement 'Show Me Before You Buy' feature UI as a core component in the chat/task detail. Build the Multi-step Booking flow with clear progressive disclosure. Admin dashboard should feature data tables for PA management and task tracking. strictly follow the saffron orange and white color scheme to evoke a trustworthy Indian brand. Include Telugu translation placeholders if necessary, though English is primary.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing ones.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., 'transition-colors').
Do not use transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-pa-button').
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠.
For toasts, utilize the sonner library.
Create depth with appropriate shadows and clean borders, avoiding 'AI slop' uniform gradients.
